mission.title: V.E.N.O.M. strikes: {Location}
mission.outline:
1. A hook: news, a tip-off, or a V.E.N.O.M. vehicle seen somewhere it shouldn't be.
2. Investigation: work out what V.E.N.O.M. wants and how before {Crew} strikes. The M.A.S.K. Guide's Agent roster page lists their vehicles.
3. The chase: vehicles in Civilian Mode, then Strike Mode when the masks come out.
4. The showdown, and the complication at the worst moment.
